name: LinearGradient
description: The LinearGradient object transitions through a series of colors in a linear manner along a specific angle.
remarks: Attempting to access the Gradient property of an Interior object that does not have an existing gradient fill results in a run-time error. Be aware of the Pattern property before accessing the Gradient property. If the Pattern property is changed from a gradient type to a non-gradient type, the Gradient property will populate with default values.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ColorStops
properties.description: Returns the ColorStops object for the LinearGradient object. Read-only.

properties.name: Degree
properties.description: The angle of the linear gradient fill within a selection. Read/write.
